senses.zh_definition: 罗曼诺夫：俄语姓氏 Romanov 的另一种拉丁字母拼写，尤指俄罗斯罗曼诺夫皇室。
senses.en_definition: An alternative spelling of the Russian surname Romanov, especially the name of Russia’s former imperial dynasty.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Rusia yang juga dieja Romanov, khususnya nama keluarga diraja yang memerintah Rusia dari tahun 1613 hingga tahun 1917.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应写作 Romanoff；此处保留输入词头的小写形式。不能脱离上下文将所有同姓者都认定为皇室成员。本条为专名释义，并非 DBP 普通词条；status 按任务格式保留，不代表 DBP 规范认证。[俄克拉何马大学：The Romanoffs](https://www.ou.edu/cas/romanoff/about/romanoffs)。

etymology.historical_story: Romanoff and Romanov are alternative Latin spellings of the same Russian family name. The dynasty began ruling Russia in 1613, when Mikhail Romanoff became tsar, and its rule ended with Nicholas II’s abdication in 1917. These spelling variants help explain why the same imperial family appears under different names in historical writing. [University of Oklahoma](https://www.ou.edu/cas/romanoff/about/romanoffs).
